title: covectorEuclideanNorm is the ℓ²-norm of the increasing coordinates (sum over SimonMultiIndex k P)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) k be a k-covector on ℝ^P = Eucl P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P). By definition covectorEuclideanNorm α = √(Σ_{f : Fin k → Fin P} [f strictly increasing] · α(basisFun(f(0)), …, basisFun(f(k−1)))²), where basisFun = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ. Then covectorEuclideanNorm α = Real.sqrt (Σ_{I ∈ SimonMultiIndex k P} (euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I)²). Here the sum runs over all order embeddings I : Fin k ↪o Fin P, and euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I = α(EuclideanSpace.single (I 0) 1, …, EuclideanSpace.single (I (k−1)) 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), covectorEuclideanNorm α = Real.sqrt (∑ I : SimonMultiIndex k P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I ^ 2)
